Fixes for what v0.1.0 got wrong on a real Windows install. If you installed
v0.1.0, install this over it: your library, videos and settings are kept.

## Downloads

| | file | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Voxframe-0.1.1-Windows-setup.exe` | Not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen will ask you to confirm. [How to install](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/docs/install-windows.md) |
| **macOS (Apple Silicon) — early** | `Voxframe-0.1.1-macOS-arm64.dmg` | **Early build.** Unsigned, so macOS will ask you to confirm in System Settings. Apple Silicon Macs only. [How to open it](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/docs/install-mac.md) |

Check a download against `SHA256SUMS`, attached below.

Both downloads include FFmpeg 9.0.2, which is licensed under the GPL, as a
separate program. Its complete source is attached to this release
(`ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz`, with FFmpeg's signature `ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz.asc`), with
`ffmpeg-9.0.2-libraries.txt`: the libraries compiled into each build and where
their source is published.

## Fixed

- **Pictures.** In v0.1.0 the installed app could not run its picture model: a
  part it needs was left out of the installer. Every downloaded image was
  rejected and videos came out with plain backgrounds. The installer now
  includes it, and if the model ever cannot load, Voxframe says so at once —
  before spending time on a video — instead of making one without pictures.
- **Long recordings get pictures throughout.** v0.1.0 searched online for the
  first 40 scenes only. Scenes that share a subject now share one search, the
  whole recording is covered, and images are reused rather than downloaded
  again. On a 17-minute talk (107 scenes), every scene got an image: 52 their
  own, the rest calm images on the talk's theme, labelled "atmospheric" in the
  scene plan. If an image service does run out of requests, Voxframe tells you
  which, and making the video again carries on from there.
- **No more flashing windows** while a video is made.
- **Voxframe stays visible.** Its small "Voxframe is running" window now opens
  (it did not in v0.1.0). Close the browser tab and you can reopen Voxframe
  from that window, or by opening Voxframe again — which now opens the running
  copy instead of saying it is already open. A copy left over from a crash no
  longer stops it from starting.

## Privacy

Your recordings and videos stay on your computer. See
[the privacy note](https://github.com/Ngum12/voxframe/blob/main/docs/privacy.md).
